meta.triageRationale: bugfix (small): one function in the VS Code picker plus its tests; routed issue -> build with no LLD.

body.focus: Fix ISSUE-07dfdf71974a7c45 (docs/standalone/make-vs-code-tier-picker-show-E2026102707dfdf71/ISSUE.md): the VS Code model-tier picker's starting tier (currentTier, vscode-plugin/src/models/model-tier-picker.ts:145-158) must be the tier the daemon resolves, under the daemon's rules (src/config/analyze.ts:216 tierSetting, parseTiering :395-407, src/daemon/model-registry.ts:274 droppedEffort): a configured runner (a family the definitions serve) AND non-empty model run with the configured effort or none; any other tier (unset, model '', a runner or model alone) is the default family's tier default, at the configured effort leaf, else the default's effort; an effort the resolved model does not accept is shown as none. Parity tests cover each rule.
body.summary: The VS Code tier picker now marks as current the tier the daemon actually runs; parity tests cover each of the daemon's rules and fail on the old code.
